ground_contacts.name: LEFT_SKID
ground_contacts.source: Estimate: the sizing has no landing gear geometry. x: the front lift rotor hub (x_f). y: -boom_y. Both of the H4_12S sizing result. z: the lowest point of the fuselage frames (1.2.2.2, z 0.0700 m) and of the prop_cruise disc (hub z + D/2, z 0.2890 m), plus rotor.tip_clearance_m of settings/rosella.json (0.02 m, stand-in: gap between prop discs and the nearest structure). Spring and damping: copy of the TAIL_SKID of aircraft/currawong.
